description: Architects Registration Board - New Registration and Renewal of Registration of Chartered Architects, Architects and Architectural Licentiates for the Year 2016/2017 (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the registration and renewal of registration for "Chartered Architects", "Architects", and "Architectural Licentiates" by the Architects Registration Board. This is a business/commercial matter involving professional licensing and certification for individuals to practice architecture, which falls under the Commercial (Type 6) classification category for business and commercial regulatory matters.
